svg.text: Red = cut through (holes and screen cutouts). Blue = centre lines, centre marks and screen outlines, do not cut. Hole positions are measured from the CENTRE.
Screen cutouts = screen + 5 mm on width and length (depth not added). Angles: anticlockwise from the +x centre line (to the right), plan seen from above. Inside corners take the bit radius.
